summary.text: Tanya Storer is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 43, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Tanya Storer's occupation as a rancher.

paragraphs.text: Tanya Storer was born Tanya Adamson on January 20, 1969, in Gordon.
Tanya Storer graduated from Valentine Rural High School in 1986 and earned a B.S. in consumer science and education from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1990.
Tanya Storer served as a Cherry County commissioner from 2014 to 2022 and on the Nebraska Farm Bureau state board from 2010 to 2016.
Tanya Storer is a member of the Nebraska Farm Bureau and Nebraska Cattlemen.
Tanya Storer married Eric Storer on May 20, 1989, and they have three children.
